decision_reason: Authenticated browser and container evidence reproduce the failure after trust validation, and the public temporary preview API provides a scoped compatibility path without changing read-only platform code.

causal_assessment.hypothesis: kkFileView 4.1.0 cannot derive a filename suffix from generic attachment object keys that end in a UUID.
supporting_evidence: the trusted source URL path ends with an extensionless UUID
the container stack fails in WebUtils.encodeUrlFileName while searching for a dot suffix
the platform temporary preview service stores objects as UUID plus the validated extension
causal_assessment.falsifier: the same real attachment renders successfully through the generic attachment preview URL without a filename hint

invariants: attachment authorization remains enforced by the platform APIs
platform file-preview and attachment source code remains unchanged
the original filename and content type are preserved
temporary preview objects are deleted when the dialog closes or the page unmounts
control_action.rollback: restore ReportsPage previewReport to the generic attachment preview call and remove temporary preview cleanup state
correction_check: authenticated real XLSX preview renders a non-empty table
no trust, HTTP 500 or loading error appears
closing the dialog returns HTTP 200 from DELETE /api/file-previews/{previewId}

residual_risk: the compatibility flow transfers the attachment through the browser once before preview upload
